thread:
Hannah: Quick FYI 90min change window tonight 03:30-05:00 UTC for release/2024.07. Scope: terraform state split for tenant-x (split shared->tenant state), IAM role rename to support cross-account tagging, and provider bump.
Hannah: Need an apply owner + someone to watch rollback triggers. Marco, you free to run applies?
Marco: I can. Will be oncall. What's the exact rollback criteria?
Sanjay: Rollback triggers: deploybot apply failure; state drift detected on >2 resources; or downstream 5xx spike >6/min for 10m. Manual rollback if p95 increases >150ms for 10m.
state-backup-bot: Snapshotting remote state: s3://infra-snaps/release-2024-07/tenant-x-1771112223.tfstate.gz
deploybot: preflight OK 93 plan ready. Provider pin: aws v4.86.0 (lock: k9l8m7).
Marco: Plan command I'll run locally:
```
cd infra/tenants/tenant-x
terraform init -reconfigure -backend-config=prod.backend
terraform plan -out=plan.tenantx -var-file=tenant-x.tfvars
```
Hannah: Sequence: split state in east first (us-east-1) -> apply rename of iam roles (non-breaking aliasing) -> smoke -> then split west. Do NOT auto-approve west until smoke green.
qa-runner: Quick smoke script: `./ci/smoke-tenant-x.sh` 94 runs health checks + assume-role test.
Marco: Starting us-east state split and apply at 1771112300. Locking remote state.
deploybot: state split operation initiated by Marco at 1771112310
deploybot: apply started (us-east-1) at 1771112320
Marco: Seeing an unexpected plan diff: iam_role.redwood_tenant_x will be renamed (resource replacement) but aliasing should avoid downtime. Confirming with Sanjay.
Sanjay: We added `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }` in the module, so rename should be safe. Proceed.
deploybot: apply completed (us-east-1) at 1771112350 94 success
Marco: Running smoke checks now.
qa-runner: Smoke OK 5/5, assume-role passes. Minimal errors.
Marco: Kicking west plan but holding approval until 8m after east.
Hannah: Watching metrics. If any drift shows up in IAM policies (deploybot drift check) we abort.
deploybot: preflight for ap-southeast-1 OK 94 plan ready.
Marco: Starting west apply at 1771112385
deploybot: apply started (ap-southeast-1) at 1771112386
deploybot: apply failed at 1771112398 94 error: drift detected - iam_policy.billing_role differs from state (attached policies mismatch)
Sanjay: Hmm, looks like an out-of-band change from billing account automation. @Marco do not force apply. We'll follow runbook: fetch live policy, compare, and reconcile.
Marco: Running `aws iam get-policy-version` to inspect and pulling remote into tmp file.
state-backup-bot: Pulled remote policy and stored at s3://infra-snaps/release-2024-07/tenant-x/policy-drift-1771112399.json
Sanjay: Reconcile options: 1) revert remote change via ops (preferred), 2) update our terraform to match remote (requires approval), or 3) fallback by aborting west and rolling east back.
Hannah: Ops confirmed they made a transient billing change, will revert in 5m. Hold applies.
deploybot: re-run preflight after remote change reverts.
deploybot: preflight OK at 1771112400 94 plan ready.
Marco: Re-running west apply now.
deploybot: apply started (ap-southeast-1) at 1771112400
deploybot: apply completed (ap-southeast-1) at 1771112400 94 success
Marco: All done. Uploading final state snapshot and adding notes to release: "Infra: tenant-x state split, IAM role rename; transient billing policy drift handled (no rollback)."
Hannah: Thanks everyone. Closing window and updating Confluence + #releases. :thumbsup:
